The task asks whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. The claims are prior migration report statements about V02 and V05 signals. The hypothesis concerns V01 (3-month change, standardized over 60 months, in the high-T regime). It does not reference any claim by number, and it tests a different variable than claims 3 to 9.

It does loosely relate to the regime-dependence noted in claims 5 and 6, and to the next step in claim 11 (test interaction with T, faster-moving features). But the hypothesis is about V01, not V02, so it does not directly test claim 11. It also does not reference or test any numbered claim explicitly.
